'''Opf''' was a guard working for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Mahk'khar]]. He was part of the ten-person guard force left behind at Mahk'khar's [[Mahk'khars Palace|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tuulab]] to ambush a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operations team. In the ensuring skirmish, Opf panicked since it was his first battle and triggered the palace's internal security array.
